episode_title: Ep. 317 Dave Portnoy & Barstool: Big Noon Kickoff vs. College Gameday

real_qa.q: How many average weekly viewers does ESPN College GameDay pull compared to Fox Big Noon Kickoff?
real_qa.r: College GameDay averages about 2.2 million viewers per episode with peaks at 2.9 million, while Big Noon Kickoff averaged about $952,000 through Week 7 last year, though it did reach 1.5 million on Week 2 and briefly outpaced GameDay.
real_qa.requete: College GameDay viewers Big Noon Kickoff

real_qa.q: Why was Dave Portnoy banned from Ohio State stadium during Big Noon Kickoff coverage?
real_qa.r: Ohio State Athletic Director denied banning Portnoy and said it was Fox's decision, stating that Fox representatives informed the department that only their main desk talent team would be allowed inside Ohio Stadium, and Portnoy is not part of that main crew. However, Portnoy indicated there was major pressure coming from Ohio State that led Fox to pull the plug on their pregame show about a week before the game.
real_qa.requete: Dave Portnoy banned Ohio State Big Noon Kickoff

real_qa.q: Is Big Noon Kickoff limited to Big Ten conference games only?
real_qa.r: Yes, Big Noon Kickoff is exclusively Big Ten and covers only the biggest Big Ten game of the week at noon on Fox. The show is constrained to Big Ten matchups, unlike College GameDay which can cover games from any conference including the SEC, ACC, and Big 12.
real_qa.requete: Big Noon Kickoff Big Ten only exclusive

real_qa.q: Did Dave Portnoy previously get banned from an NFL Super Bowl event?
real_qa.r: Yes, Portnoy was previously banned from a Patriots Super Bowl where he snuck in and was carried out from the stands. This created a legendary photo and video that became famous in Barstool's history and inspired people to work for Dave and join Barstool.
real_qa.requete: Dave Portnoy banned Super Bowl NFL

real_qa.q: What is Ferg's Bar and Grill's recognition by USA Today?
real_qa.r: Ferg's Bar and Grill in St. Pete was named the number one local sports bar in the U.S. by USA Today, making it a notable destination for sports fans watching college and NFL games.
real_qa.requete: Ferg's Bar Grill St. Pete USA Today
